name: – Emma Ytterell – Article 7, after § 1 – Am 116
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 1a. By way of derogation from paragraph 1, for projects for the construction or renovation of residential buildings, water infrastructure projects contributing to water security, drought resilience or flood protection, including water storage facilities, reservoirs, dams, drainage systems and flood defence infrastructure, and projects for the modernisation of agricultural and livestock holdings and of irrigation infrastructure, including water storage, water reuse and on-farm water management systems, Member States shall ensure that: (a) the screening is carried out within a maximum of 30 days from the date on which the developer has submitted all information required; where the competent authority has not taken a screening decision within that period, the project shall be deemed not to require an environmental impact assessment, unless the project may pose a demonstrable and significant risk to the safety of residents in its vicinity; (b) where an environmental impact assessment is required, the complete environmental assessment, excluding the preparation of the environmental impact assessment report by the developer, does not exceed 90 days.
